blocks.text:
Arrival in Rio de Janeiro. Transfer to the hotel. 

If you arrive before dawn, you will see green hills, rocky mountains, palm trees on both sides of the road and beautiful bays on the way from the airport. As darkness falls, the city is surrounded by a shimmering necklace – these are the lights of the favelas!   The famous Copacabana and Ipanema, lined with black and white tiles and open until late at night, cozy cafes where you can quench your thirst with cold coconut water! All this is in front of you, because you are in Rio de Janeiro - one of the most beautiful and exotic cities in the  world!

blocks.text: 31 December: Corcovado and New Year's Eve on Copacabana

provenance.rationale: The heading combines the approved 31 December date, Corcovado excursion and New Year's Eve celebration on Copacabana.

blocks.text:
Breakfast. Meeting in the lobby of the hotel with the guide.

 Excursion to Mount Corcovado to the statue of Christ (4 hours) with an English-speaking guide.

Arrival at the station, from where  we take a special open eco-friendly train through the jungle to the top of the Corcovado hill. On both sides of the road, there are breathtaking views of the Tijuca forest. At the top of the Corcovado hill, at an altitude of 710 m above sea level, rises the symbol of Rio - the statue of Christ the Redeemer (38 m), which was erected in 1931.  the bridge in Niterói, Guanabara Bay, the Botanical Garden, the world's largest stadium Maracanã, Sugarloaf and much more.

We advise you to have a good rest and prepare for the New Year. 

In the evening, an unforgettable holiday awaits you on the beach of Copacabana! New Year's Eve in Rio is a grand event not only for tourists, but also for locals.  It is launched on Copacabana beach from platforms located directly in the water. Residents of Brazil celebrate the New Year in white clothes. Believers pay tribute to the goddess of water Imanja. They put their gifts in tiny boats and send them to the ocean. And all this to the lights of fireworks falling into the water. The spectacle is truly mesmerizing! Also on the beach there are podiums for the performance of famous artists, who can be listened to this night by anyone - the concert is free! The fun continues all night. 

*If you wish, you can book a New Year's Eve dinner or a party ticket at one of  the hotels on the Copacabana waterfront, cost on request
